admitted.nl: The two 2 markers define the persistent two-cell block from the minimum to maximum marked column; rows containing 1 or 3 become solid in that color, while every other row gets the 2 block.
Rows marked by colors other than 2 are expanded across the row; all rows without such markers use the bounding horizontal span of the 2 markers.
Color 2 is the background tile: its marked column range is painted on every row, but any row containing a 1 or 3 overrides the tile with a full stripe of that color.
Extract the 2-marker horizontal segment and replicate it; preserve every non-2 marker row as a monochromatic horizontal line.
The 2s establish a repeated motif spanning their columns; 1 and 3 act as row commands that overwrite the motif with their own color.
